formats.name: Organic video post

video.captions: burned-in or TikTok auto-captions; keep text off the right-edge action rail and bottom caption area

safe_zone.note: TikTok publishes no organic safe zone. Right rail (like/comment/share/profile) and bottom caption/username/music overlay cover content; use the ad safe zone from tiktok.ads.in_feed.video as a proxy.

formats.notes: Max length differs by upload path: TikTok Help Center (TikTok Studio, desktop) says uploads up to 30 minutes, MP4 or WebM, 720x1280 or higher, under 10 GB. Developer API: every creator can post 3-minute videos, some 5 or 10 minutes; API max 4 GB, 360-4096 px each side, 23-60 fps. Widely repeated '60 minutes' claims are from creator posts, not TikTok docs. Caption: API direct-post title max 2,200 UTF-16 runes; third-party guides cite 4,000 in-app (unverified). 1080x1920 canvas is our render choice; TikTok states only minimums.

formats.notes: Limits are from the Content Posting API photo-post spec: up to 35 images, max 1080p, JPEG or WebP, max 20 MB per image; title max 90 and description max 4,000 UTF-16 runes. In-app upload may accept more types. TikTok publishes no official organic Photo Mode aspect ratio; 9:16 at 1080x1920 is our render choice (accepted_aspects null). Music can be added; older newsroom post cites 2,200-character captions (superseded by the 4,000 API limit).

formats.name: In-Feed video ad

safe_zone.note: TikTok publishes the ad safe zone as a downloadable .zip overlay (standard LTR and Arabic RTL) on the Auction In-Feed help page; its size depends on dimension, ad-caption length and interactive add-ons (longer caption = smaller safe zone). The zip could not be downloaded here, so pixel margins are null. Right-side action rail, bottom caption, display name and CTA cover content.

formats.notes: Minimums: 9:16 >= 540x960, 16:9 >= 960x540, 1:1 >= 640x640. Bitrate >= 516 kbps (reservation in-feed lists >= 2,500 kbps). Duration up to 10 minutes for auction non-Spark; reservation in-feed is 5-60 s (recommend 9-15 s). Ad text: preview tool shows a 0/100 counter; 'Advertising on TikTok' says max 100 English characters, 4-60 recommended; captions use fixed white font and do not support clickable links, @ mentions or hashtags. Display name (account name) shows on one line: up to 20 characters (10 for CJK), 4-10 recommended (reservation page). Profile image: 98x98 px, jpg/jpeg/png, under 50 KB, key element inside the centre 66x66 px. 1080x1920 canvas is our render choice. ads.tiktok.com is DNS-blocked on the research machine (resolves to 0.0.0.0), so TikTok Ads Help pages were read through search-engine excerpts of the official pages, not a direct fetch. Re-verify in Ads Manager before launch.

formats.name: Spark Ad (boosted organic post)
formats.notes: Spark Ads run an existing organic TikTok post under the creator's or brand's identity (profile photo and name come from that account). Official pages conflict: About Spark Ads says no duration restriction but also cites a 10-minute maximum for sparkable videos; auction in-feed says no duration restriction. Caption is pulled from the organic post and can't be edited after authorization; about 4 lines show before 'See more'; TikTok suggests ~100 characters; reservation page cites max 150, TopView max 100. No ratio/resolution/file restrictions for pull-mode Spark Ads. Design to tiktok.feed.video. ads.tiktok.com is DNS-blocked on the research machine (resolves to 0.0.0.0), so TikTok Ads Help pages were read through search-engine excerpts of the official pages, not a direct fetch. Re-verify in Ads Manager before launch.
